There's no shortage of advice out there

You don't need more information.
You need to know how to make it work.

You're eating protein like your life depends on it. Your health to-do list is as long as your arm. From one thing to the other. Get morning sunlight. Cold plunge. Sauna. No screens after 8pm. Red light therapy. Balance your hormones. Drink your electrolytes. Keep your cortisol down. Not too much Cardio.

You've saved the recipes. Followed the influencers. Bought the protein powder. Tried the apps.

And yet somehow, you're still trying to put all the pieces together.

Because knowing what you should be doing and knowing how to get the basics right for your body, your goals and your actual life are two very different things.

That's where I help you cut through the noise.

The Self-Care Method

Learn. Build. Become.

01 · Nourish

Learn how to eat.

Learn how to fuel your body, build balanced meals, understand macros, navigate portions and make food choices that support your goals.

Food becomes something you understand — not something you're constantly trying to control.

02 · Strength

Learn how to train.

Understand why strength training matters, what effective training looks like and how to move your body in a way that supports your strength, muscle, fitness and health.

We're training for the body you want to live in for decades.

03 · Habits

Build your system.

We build routines, systems and strategies around your actual life — your work, family, weekends, social life, stress and all the other things that don't disappear because you've decided to get healthier.

The plan has to work while life is happening.

04 · Self-Care

Become her.

We stop chasing the outcome and start building the identity.

Instead of asking, “What do I need to do to get there?” we start asking, “Who is the woman I want to become — and how does she take care of herself?”

Become the woman first.
Let the outcomes follow.

Why three months of coaching?

Learn it. Practise it. Own it.

This isn't a 30-day challenge. And three months isn't a deadline for becoming a new person. For coaching to stick and identity to begin to shift, I recommend giving yourself at least three months. It's enough time for us to stop guessing, start learning what works for you and practise it long enough to begin making it your own.

Month 1 · Learn

Understand yourself.

We establish your starting point, who you want to become and what your body actually needs. We strip it back to basics — simplify your nutrition, look at your movement and training, understand your routines and identify the patterns that need shifting.

We stop guessing.

Month 2 · Practise

Make it work.

Busy workdays. Weekends. Restaurants. Holidays. Stress. Low motivation. Great weeks. Messy ones. We test our systems. We adjust. Problem-solve. Learn.

We build a solid foundation that can withstand real life.

Month 3 · Own

Become her.

You understand your body better. You recognise your patterns. You've built routines you can return to when life knocks things sideways. You're not just following instructions anymore.

You're trusting yourself and keeping your promises.
